title: Fracture mechanism and multi-field interaction effects of supercritical CO2–water–coal rock coupling
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2466-2477
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00870G, Paper
Fei Yu, Guangzhe Deng, Chao Yuan
A novel supercritical CO2 fracturing device developed in-house was employed to devise experimental schemes utilizing water at various temperatures as a heat-carrying fluid.
